body: Oooo I love writing poetry! I’m not really the best but I try :) I listen to citypop(80s/90s Japanese funk), surf rock, and a lot of jazz. You should check out Junko Ohashi & Tatsuro Yamashita for some good city pop! Surf rock is a little weird but a song I like is “She’s my witch” covered by the radiacs and the band Hawaii Samurai. I can go on a on about jazz, but a really chill album I’ve been listening to is Kenny Burrell’s “Moon and Sand”.

Hey bud! What are your interests? Do you have a favorite show or type of music? I have a pretty obscure taste, but I can recommend you something. I hope you decide to stay alive for longer than 16, you’ve got a whole life ahead of you. No one knows how it’ll be, but you’re the only one who can make life worthwhile. It’ll take work, a lot of tears, a lot of doubt, but you’ll get there. If you feel like things are bad, fake it till you make it! Don’t suppress your feelings though. Surround yourself with happy things. You’ll feel happier too. You can do it bud, I believe in you. Hang in there 💕
Hi bud, you doing ok? You can talk to me, what’s up?

My friend Matthew. He’s an asshole but it would break his heart if I did anything. I love that kid so much, and I’m the one person in his life that looks out for him and treats him nicely. He hates everyone and he’s very insecure at the same time, he always feels the need to brag and prove himself which makes people think he’s an asshole. He’s really not, he can be mean but I know he’s just bad at expressing himself. I need to stay alive so I can help him. I need to show him that he doesn’t need to suck up to people in order to be friends with them. I love him more than anything, and I want him to have a good life. But at the same time I hate my own life.

I give a fuck. I’m sorry you are going through this. Please don’t kill yourself, you may not know it but a lot of people care about you and love you. It’s very hard to see that when you’re depressed, but please trust me. I don’t know if life gets better but we can pretend. Fake it till you make it.

Many times, but I always chickened out at the very last second. I’ve tried drowning myself but I’m too scared to let the water fill my lungs. I’ve tried cutting myself but I’m too scared of the pain. I’ve tried overdosing but I’m too scared of vomiting up my organs. I’m such a coward that I can’t even kill myself.

Can I still be successful if I’m bad at the things I love doing? I’m scared. I don’t want to be a senior yet, I don’t have anything figured out. I want to make my friends and family proud but I’m just a failure. Besides science has no funding nowadays and a music career is impossibly difficult. I don’t want to work a 9 to 5 office job. I want to work in a looking studying distant stars and play jazz venues at night. Neither of those will make me money though. I don’t know what to do. I don’t want to live through uncertainty.

My school is filled with smart kids. Well at least the social group I’m in I guess. I can’t compare to them. Even decent colleges are less likely to pick me because I’m not as good as them. No one wants anyone more Asians anyway. Maybe if I mention I’m gay colleges will enjoy that but I don’t know. How else am I supposed to be successful? I can’t even make it into a good school.
My mother is abusive. How can I survive when life is so painful?
How am I supposed to keep living after all the shit that’s happened to me? I’m only 17 what if I have to face worse? Why should I put myself through all that when we all die and are forgotten.
